name: Slang AI
oneLiner: Voice AI phone host for restaurants: answers every call, handles questions and reservations, and connects to reservation and event platforms; its Superhost product (Oct 2026) adds guest memory for full-service restaurants.
bestFor: Full-service and reservation-driven restaurants and groups that miss calls during service and want an AI host that handles reservations and questions, rather than live phone ordering.

updates.text: Raised a $36M Series B led by US Venture Partners (total funding $68M); Slang said it served 2,000+ restaurant locations.
Launched Superhost for full-service restaurants: remembers prior conversations, preferences and visit history, follows restaurant-set policy controls, and speaks nearly 100 languages.

features: Answers every inbound call 24/7 in a natural voice
Handles common questions (hours, location, menu, policies)
Takes and changes reservations through OpenTable, SevenRooms and Yelp integrations
Routes private-event inquiries (Tripleseat integration) and hands off to staff when needed
Texts callers links, e.g. to online ordering, instead of taking orders by voice
Superhost guest memory: recognizes regulars and their preferences
Restaurant-defined policy controls and custom greetings

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Slang AI does not publish prices.
